verdict.rationale: GitHub's own writing-and-formatting docs state you can 'create sophisticated formatting for your prose and code on GitHub with simple syntax', which covers the core of the story: Markdown that renders formatted prose and code. Only that single doc summary is in the pack, with no detail on where the syntax applies or how code is rendered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that syntax highlighting is applied to fenced code blocks, explicit coverage of READMEs, issues and comments as the surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
